landing.badge: No clicks needed · Just raise your hand
landing.heroTitle: Quizzes just got way more fun
landing.heroSubtitle: Answer with a wave of your hand — no clicks needed!
landing.feature1Body: Just hold up 1–5 fingers to choose. Our friendly hand-tracking reads your gesture and locks it in.
landing.feature2Body: A quick glance at the camera now and then keeps things fair — no scary proctoring software.
landing.feature3Body: Teachers drop in their notes and — poof! — a ready-to-play quiz appears in seconds.
landing.feature4Body: Try as many times as you want in practice mode, with instant feedback to help you improve.
landing.feature5Body: Colorful dashboards show your scores and streaks, so you always know how you're doing.
landing.feature6Body: Pop in a class code, do a quick high-five to the webcam, and you're in the game.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to make quizzes the best part of class?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Grab a join code from your teacher and wave your way to better grades.
landing.footerCopy: © 2026 InnoVision · Learning, but make it fun
